description: Fires when column 1 (second from left) is full, most strongly on the move that fills it (the opponent just dropped the sixth stone there), once about 12+ stones are on the board, growing with move count. With column 1 already full it also fires late in the game (about 37+ stones), more so when column 1's top stone is the opponent's and the last move was in column 0, 2 or 6. Stacking other columns does nothing.
effect: None measurable: forcing it high or off changes move probabilities by at most ~3 points in any column (column 1 is already full when it fires).
notes: Layer 0. Band 9 is 100% 'last move filled column 1'. Fill-move-only rule: F1 0.617 (P .77). Adding late-game col-1-full positions: best F1 0.645 (P .53 R .84, AUROC .91), sim share 0.47. The late-game plateau (col 1 full, ply 30-41) hovers near threshold and is only partly predicted (ply, top-stone owner parity, last-move column); recency since fill was tested and rejected. Steering effect negligible. Synthesis up to 4.487 > dev max 4.430.
